title: Vibrant Sour Egyptian Lamb Tagine
description: A sour and flavorful Egyptian dish featuring lamb, lemongrass, and bhuna spices, perfect for a hangover cure. This kosher-friendly recipe is made with tender lamb and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the bruised lemongrass stalks, bhuna spice mix, and diced tomatoes.
Stir to combine, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Remove the lemongrass stalks and stir in the chopped parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot over rice or couscous.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
